accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the first electoral performance of the Telugu Desam Party?
o: It won 202 seats in 1985 and formed the first Congress government.
It won 177 seats in 1983 and formed a coalition government.
It won 202 seats in 1983 and formed the first non-Congress government in Andhra Pradesh.
It won 79 seats in 1983, all from Telangana.
accepted.x: The Telugu Desam Party won 202 seats in the 1983 election and formed the first non-Congress government in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive seat tally and the political consequence together to reject swapped election results.
accepted.sec: Founding of the Telugu Desam Party - year, founder, CM then, first win  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: N.T. Rama Rao was first sworn in as Chief Minister after the 1983 election at which place and with what initial cabinet strength?
accepted.x: N.T. Rama Rao was sworn in on 9 January 1983 at Lal Bahadur Stadium, with an initial cabinet of 15 members.
accepted.tq: Pair the venue with the numerical detail instead of treating the date alone as sufficient.
accepted.sec: Founding of the Telugu Desam Party - year, founder, CM then, first win  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Who among the following was the Deputy Chief Minister in N.T. Rama Rao’s initial cabinet?
accepted.x: Nadendla Bhaskara Rao served as Deputy Chief Minister in N.T. Rama Rao’s initial cabinet.
accepted.tq: Test the office-holder directly while using nearby Andhra political figures as plausible distractors.
accepted.sec: Founding of the Telugu Desam Party - year, founder, CM then, first win  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Leader)
a. Neelam Sanjiva Reddy
a. P.V. Narasimha Rao
c. Damodaram Sanjivayya
d. N.T. Rama Rao
List-II (National office)
i. Prime Minister of India
ii. Chairman, National Front
iii. President of India
iv. AICC President

Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
accepted.x: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was President of India, P.V. Narasimha Rao was Prime Minister, Damodaram Sanjivayya was AICC President, and N.T. Rama Rao was Chairman of the National Front.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate codes containing a swapped national office.
accepted.sec: AP leaders in national office → post  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was elected President of India in which year?
accepted.x: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was elected President of India in 1977. He had earlier served as AICC President in 1960.
accepted.tq: Separate the year of the national constitutional office from the year of party leadership.
accepted.sec: AP leaders in national office → post  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which statement is correct regarding Neelam Sanjiva Reddy’s 1977 electoral significance?
o: He was elected Chairman of the National Front in 1977.
He won the first election to the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly in 1977.
He was the only Congress candidate to win in Andhra Pradesh in 1977.
He was the only Janata candidate to win in Andhra Pradesh in 1977.
accepted.x: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was the only Janata candidate to win in Andhra Pradesh in the 1977 election.
accepted.tq: Use the party label and state-specific distinction to catch a reversed political association.
accepted.sec: AP leaders in national office → post  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the political crisis of August–September 1984:
1. Governor Ram Lal dismissed N.T. Rama Rao’s government while NTR was in the United States for medical treatment.
2. Nadendla Bhaskara Rao was sworn in as Chief Minister on 16 August 1984.
3. Nadendla Bhaskara Rao resigned on 16 September 1984, after which N.T. Rama Rao was restored.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The dismissal by Governor Ram Lal led to Nadendla Bhaskara Rao’s short-lived ministry and NTR’s restoration after Nadendla resigned.
accepted.tq: Link the governor’s action, the replacement ministry and the restoration in a single event sequence.
accepted.sec: 1983 and 1984 political crises - Governor's role, restoration  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The 1984 dismissal of N.T. Rama Rao’s government was widely regarded as which of the following in Andhra Pradesh politics?
o: The first division of the ruling party
The first coalition experiment in the State
The first coup-style takeover in the State
The first invocation of President’s Rule in the State
accepted.x: The dismissal and replacement of NTR’s government in August 1984 was described as the first coup-style takeover in the State.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact political characterisation rather than a broadly related constitutional event.
accepted.sec: 1983 and 1984 political crises - Governor's role, restoration  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which constitutional development was associated with the political crisis involving N.T. Rama Rao and Nadendla Bhaskara Rao?
accepted.x: The episode contributed to the anti-defection law enacted through the 52nd Constitutional Amendment in 1985.
accepted.tq: Match the political consequence with the correct constitutional amendment number and year.
accepted.sec: 1983 and 1984 political crises - Governor's role, restoration  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. N.T. Rama Rao was sworn in again as Chief Minister.
B. Nadendla Bhaskara Rao was sworn in as Chief Minister.
C. Indira Gandhi was assassinated.
D. Mid-term elections were held.
accepted.x: Nadendla Bhaskara Rao was sworn in on 16 August 1984, Indira Gandhi was assassinated on 31 October, mid-term polls were held on 28 December, and NTR was sworn in again on 9 March 1985.
accepted.tq: Fix the first event by its August date and then distinguish the October, December and March events.
accepted.sec: 1983 and 1984 political crises - Governor's role, restoration  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Telangana Praja Samithi was formed in 1969, not 1972. In September 1972, it merged with the Congress.
accepted.tq: Find the event whose year has been shifted to a nearby year in the same political sequence.
accepted.sec: Coalition and split events → year  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Who formed the Congress (I) on 1 January 1978?
accepted.x: Indira Gandhi formed Congress (I) on 1 January 1978, while Brahmananda Reddy led the rival Reddy Congress.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the founder of a faction from the leader of the rival faction.
accepted.sec: Coalition and split events → year  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about party formations and splits in Andhra Pradesh:
1. N.G. Ranga was associated with the formation of the Swatantra Party in June 1959.
2. Tarimela Nagi Reddy and Chandra Pulla Reddy were associated with the formation of the CPI(ML) in 1967.
3. Marri Chenna Reddy formed the National Democratic Party on 26 February 1984.
4. Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy formed the YSR Congress Party in 2011.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The listed party formations and associated leaders correspond to 1959, 1967, 1984 and 2011 respectively.
accepted.tq: Check each leader–party–year association independently before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Coalition and split events → year  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The three-tier Panchayat Raj system was implemented in Andhra Pradesh on 1 November 1959 under which Chief Minister?
accepted.x: The three-tier Panchayat Raj system was implemented in Andhra Pradesh on 1 November 1959 under N. Sanjiva Reddy. Rajasthan was the first State to implement it on 2 October 1959.
accepted.tq: Separate the Andhra implementation date and Chief Minister from the earlier Rajasthan milestone.
accepted.sec: Panchayat Raj and local body reforms → CM + year  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Balwant Rai Mehta report was associated with which institutional development?
o: Implementation of the three-tier Panchayat Raj system
Reservation of 44 per cent seats for Backward Classes
Introduction of the Mandal system in Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: The Balwant Rai Mehta report, considered by the National Development Council in 1958, was associated with the three-tier Panchayat Raj system.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional reform linked to a committee report rather than a later NTR-era measure.
accepted.sec: Panchayat Raj and local body reforms → CM + year  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes NTR-era local-body reforms?
o: The Mandal system was introduced from 1985, and a two-thirds majority was newly prescribed in 1983.
The Mandal system was introduced from 1978, and no-confidence motions were abolished in 1983.
The Mandal system was introduced in 1983, and a three-fourths majority was substituted in 1985.
The Mandal system was introduced from 1985, and a simple majority was allowed for specified no-confidence motions in 1983.
accepted.x: NTR introduced the Mandal system from 1985 and, in 1983, permitted a simple majority for no-confidence motions against Zilla Parishad vice-chairmen instead of the earlier two-thirds majority.
accepted.tq: Compare the old and new majority requirements while keeping the two reform years distinct.
accepted.sec: Panchayat Raj and local body reforms → CM + year  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: 1957 — Elections in Telangana only, covering 79 seats
1989 — TDP formed the first non-Congress government
accepted.x: The 1957 elections were held only in Telangana and covered 79 seats. The 1962, 1978 and 1989 results have been incorrectly interchanged in the other options.
accepted.tq: Find the accurately paired year and election detail among reversed party results.
accepted.sec: Elections → year + winning party  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding elections in Andhra Pradesh:
1. In 1962, Congress won 177 seats and the Communists won more than 50 seats.
2. In 1978, Congress (I) came to power under Chenna Reddy.
3. In 1985, the Telugu Desam Party won the mid-term election.
4. In 1989, the Telugu Desam Party was defeated and Congress returned.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly state the recorded election outcomes for 1962, 1978, 1985 and 1989.
accepted.tq: Verify the sequence of party victories and defeats across successive elections.
accepted.sec: Elections → year + winning party  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Who was the first holder of the office of Dharma Mahamatra, associated with the anti-corruption initiative during the NTR period?
accepted.x: N. Vittal was the first holder of the Dharma Mahamatra office associated with the anti-corruption initiative.
accepted.tq: Match an unusual office title with its first office-holder.
accepted.sec: NTR-era reforms → initiative + first office holder  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched with an NTR-era initiative and its date?
o: Ban on private practice by government doctors — 28 April 1983
Sri Rama Pada Sagar Stage II foundation — 5 April 1983
accepted.x: The foundation of Sri Rama Pada Sagar Stage II took place on 5 May 1983, not 5 April 1983. The other three dates are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Spot a changed month in a date-based matching question.
accepted.sec: NTR-era reforms → initiative + first office holder  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly identifies the first Women’s University associated with the NTR period?
accepted.x: Tirupati had the first Women’s University referred to in the NTR-era reforms.
accepted.tq: Test the exact location of a named institutional initiative.
accepted.sec: NTR-era reforms → initiative + first office holder  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding social and educational reforms during the NTR period:
1. Equal property rights for daughters were included among the social initiatives.
2. A 44 per cent reservation was provided for Backward Classes.
3. A Buddha statue was installed in Hussain Sagar.
4. Vocational education was introduced in schools.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
